notes:
talk2me no longer types a language you do not speak. It listens only for your languages; if a stray language still comes through, it tries again in yours, or asks you to say it again.
A new question in the tour: which languages do you speak? You can change the answer in Settings > Voice. The model list then shows only the models that hear your languages. If you set up talk2me earlier, Home asks once to confirm your languages.
Repeated words are removed when filler words are removed: "the the" becomes "the". A stutter is no longer typed as "2D".
